experiment.name: Retrieval evaluation reliability
experiment.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
experiment.purpose: Measure retrieval metrics and latency over repeated trials after warm-up, with randomized strategy execution order.
experiment.latency_methodology: Warm-up calls are excluded. Each measured trial executes every strategy once in a seeded shuffled order. Per-query mean, median, minimum, maximum, and raw trial latencies are recorded. Aggregate metrics are macro-averaged across queries.
